The company

An automated supplier that sees only through the wall. It wins customers, prices, hedges, bills, collects and settles, and forms a belief about each home that it must act on while it is wrong. “Payment, credit risk and forward cash forecasting are the heart of this business.”

Read each column top to bottom, from cause to what follows. Each box carries its state, read from the maturity map at publish: Live built and at target, Building under way, Planned not started.

Where to see it working

  • Capabilities — each organ of the company, with its test and what it cannot yet do.
  • How it’s built — how the company is built and checked.
  • Explore — bills and payments for one household at a time.
  • The code — the company’s modules, behind the seam.
